title: Causal Bounds over Partial Ancestral Graph Fibers under Selection and Unfaithfulness
banked_reason: The compiler characterizes only the enumerated bounded finite legal image, while the promised all-SCM sharp fiber is expressly left open.
gap_reasons: The compiler characterizes only the enumerated bounded finite legal image, while the promised all-SCM sharp fiber is expressly left open; reframe the headline and deliverable to that bounded object (or prove the lifting property).

The exact positive-unfaithful COPAG compatibility fiber is not shown closed, finitely representable, or endpoint-attaining; all such conclusions for the full arbitrary-SCM class remain conditional on oeq:universal-legal-lifting.
This is a genuine kernel substitution relative to the accepted topic, despite the manuscript now disclosing the substitution honestly.
proof_attempt_summary: The run built an exact semialgebraic compiler for an enumerated bounded finite response-SCM image, a saturated closed-form benchmark with attained endpoint witnesses, and certified finite-branch optimization machinery. The field-level claim collapsed because sourcewise moment compression was not shown to preserve strict actual-graph legality, so the bounded image was never proved equal to the promised arbitrary-SCM COPAG fiber. The remaining load-bearing problem is oeq:universal-legal-lifting for positive, potentially unfaithful selected laws.
tldr: The exact actual-parent COPAG fiber for a positive, potentially unfaithful selected law is not proved closed.  What is established is a bounded finite graph-legal response fiber indexed by at most \(N!\) saturated orders, with essential-feature signs that exactly determine its selected MAG and singly exponential one-block real-algebraic certificates for its endpoint membership.  Independently of graph restrictions, consistency and the two calibrated selection margins give a universal closed-form outer envelope; one-source complete-COPAG witnesses attain it, and any permitted family containing those witnesses inherits the interval by sandwiching.  The binary interval \(\left[1/20,39/40\right]\) is an audit instance, not the headline.  Confidence-fiber inference provides finite-sample outer coverage for the survivor-selected cardiac-surgery use case of Lee et al., while universal legal lifting remains open.
gap: Chen and Mooij give complete point identification for COPAGs under selection, Yang et al. optimize over PAG-compatible neural SCMs under faithfulness, and Duarte et al. give sharp polynomial programs for a fixed canonical DAG. None characterizes closure or attainment after imposing the actual, rather than merely permitted, selected-MAG stratum for a positive but potentially unfaithful selected law.
fill: The project supplies an invariant essential-feature index and an if-and-only-if polynomial legality lemma, a bounded finite stratum compiler, and a certificate-producing architecture-enumeration procedure. It isolates universal graph-legal lifting as the load-bearing open question, resolves its compelled-collider kill test first, and retains finite-sample confidence-fiber coverage without asserting endpoint convergence.
